title: EU leaders seek to tackle challenges at first ever AI summit
summary: European Union leaders gather in Dublin on Friday for their first ever summit on artificial intelligence, to debate how the bloc can catch up with the United States and China and tackle funding issues and other problems.
llm_summary: European Union heads convened in Dublin for the bloc’s inaugural AI summit, aiming to close the gap with the United States and China. Delegates will hash out strategies for boosting funding, harmonising regulations and addressing other hurdles that have slowed Europe’s AI rollout. The meeting marks a coordinated push to position Europe as a competitive player in the global AI race.
